title: Motorhome & RV Bike Rack Cover, 2 Bikes – The Dirt Stays on the Outside
seo_title: Motorhome & RV Bike Rack Cover, 2 Bikes – Dirt Stays Outside
seo_description: Cover that goes over the motorhome's bike rack, for 2 bikes. Road dirt, rain and dust end up on the cover instead of on the bikes.
descriptionHtml:
The bikes take the whole trip's weather on the back of the motorhome

The bikes stay on the rack at the back for the entire trip and the entire stay, through rain and road dust, and are visible to everyone walking past at the campsite or the rest stop.

A cover that goes over both bikes

The black fabric cover goes over the two bikes on the bike rack of the motorhome or caravan. What would otherwise settle directly on the bikes – road dirt, rain, dust and bird droppings – ends up on the cover instead, and the bikes are no longer visible to passersby.

Features

  • Both bikes get protection, not just one – the cover is made for 2 bikes on the rack.
  • Road dirt and rain end up on the cover – not directly on the bikes.
  • The bikes aren't visible to passersby – the cover hides them from behind.
  • Looks discreet on the back of the vehicle – the cover is black.

Bikes and rack are not included, only the cover.

Our guarantee

14 days to change your mind – if you don't like it, you get your money back. Tracked delivery and secure checkout. 🦫
